english:
Travels in a nearly straight line with slight projectile tracking, attaches to enemies or surfaces, and explodes after 1.7 seconds.

The explosion deals up to <pve 901 /> <pvp [150] /> damage, scaling down to 0% at the edge of the 6 meter splash radius. Sticking an enemy increases explosion damage by 66.7% to <pve 1,500 /> <pvp [250] />.

source.text:
Almost Straight Trajectory | Slight Projectile Tracking | Sticky

Attaches to enemies or surfaces, exploding after 1.7 seconds.

Explosion deals up to 901 [150] damage, down to 0% damage over a 6 meter radius on detonation.
Sticking an enemy increases explosion damage by 66.7% to 1,500 [250] damage.
Base Cooldown: 105.4 seconds

Chunk Scalar: 0.875x
